result.title: Enhancing Mixed Oil Length Prediction through Graph Representation Learning
result.summary: During the pipeline transportation of refined oil products, the inevitable formation of mixed oil segments poses considerable economic challenges to pipeline networks. Therefore, it is important to accurately predict the length of these mixed oil segments. Although previous methods have achieved relatively accurate predictions by integrating machine and deep learning algorithms, they ignore the statistical dependencies that remain among real-world mixed oil samples, which degrades model accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a novel Sample Dependencies Incorporated Graph Representation Learning (SDI-GRL) model. By representing samples and pipeline features as nodes of a graph, SDI-GRL connects dependent samples through their shared features, allowing message passing to propagate information across related samples. This graph-based framework allows our model to capture the statistical dependencies among samples absent in prior works. A case study on a mixed oil dataset demonstrates that our SDI-GRL model surpasses the strongest existing approach, reducing both the RMSE and the MAE by more than 10%.
